breakdown.description: The prompt uses the twist limit directly in degrees inside a torsion formula that returns φ in radians unless the limit is converted.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to use the angle of twist (1.0°) directly in the formula φ = TL/(JG). The ground truth corrects this by removing that erroneous instruction, implying the standard conversion to radians is required. The agent, however, repeated the error by explicitly stating, 'Use the angle-of-twist formula φ = T L / (J G) with the allowable angle directly in degrees.'
